programmes.programName: Doctoral subject in Industrial Engineering and Management
programmes.school: School of Industrial Engineering and Management
programmes.evidence: KTH's current doctoral subject inventory explicitly lists Industrial Engineering and Management under the identically named school. Its opened formal syllabus gives the Swedish/English doctoral subject title and Degree of Doctor thesis requirements. Operations Management is an example research area, not an additional credential.
limitations: The formal syllabus is a 2019 revision, while KTH's current central subject inventory confirms continued listing. Do not invent a separate Operations Management doctorate.

branches.conclusion: Named Industrial Engineering and Management doctoral subject verified with current central list and opened formal syllabus; further KTH subject syllabi not exhaustively checked.
No separate KTH business-school doctoral route established; formal school subject inventories remain to check.
